notes.title: Minor Fixes for Advanced Gesture Profiles
notes.content:
Fixed some issues with the Advanced Gesture Profile engine and the default profiles:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the advanced gesture profile engine that would allow keys to become stuck in some cases.
[*]Adjusted behavior of the "await" action to always stop waiting when the associated gesture is lost, unless the Continue Processing After Gesture End option is enabled.
[*]Adjusted the Virtual Mouse and Default Point Gestures profiles to fix an issue where the pointer position would be stuck until activating the middle mouse combo for the first time.
[*]Adjusted conditional checks to consider undefined option values to also be considered disabled option values.  To determine the difference between undefined and disabled, an explicit check for undefined is required.
[/list]

notes.title: Translations Update
notes.content: Language translations have been updated to keep them in sync with the current content of the tool.

notes.title: Small Update and Bug Fix
notes.content: I have updated dependencies that may help improve tracking and fixed a rendering bug with the underlay where it would be mostly transparent when underlay background removal is turned on.

notes.title: Audio Revamp + Virtual Mouse Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The audio system has been overhauled.  There is a new section in the configuration specifically for sound, allowing independent control of gesture start, end, and interval sounds and their volume levels, with four sound choices included and the ability to select sounds from your file system.  This feature is also now available in the advanced profile editor.
[*] Both the relative version and the absolute version of the virtual mouse now both lock their positions while rolling the mouse wheel to prevent sending mouse wheel events to different windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Accidental Pinch Protection and Accidental Point Protection now also control how difficult it is to transition between the two gesture types.  Pinch protection is disabled by default, and with these settings users will no longer get stuck in point mode when trying to pinch.
[*] Added an additional safeguard against the overlay failing to be on top of other windows.  This is a bit of an arms race, as the operating system developers keep making changes to make it more difficult for unfocused programs to display in front of focused programs, but by nature of what Virtual Touch Screen 2 does, the overlay obviously needs to be on top of other programs.
[/list]

notes.title: 11 11 Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
Today I have some nice fixes that should make the tool a lot easier to use.
[list]
[*] Improved gesture transitioning for different types of pinches, reducing how often unintended gestures are triggered during transitions.
[*] Reduced the chance of unintended gestures while hands are raising or dropping.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Background Removal Share Window would show a doubled image in the background instead of removing it.  This bug was also silently hurting performance in other areas.
[*] Added a second set of green screen removal options.  This can be helpful if you have two different green screens that don't match up perfectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Added the ability to change the appearance of both contact indicators and near indicators.
Added some missing translations.
Application is now configured to not show the Steam overlay, resolving the issue with Steam overlay elements appearing erroneously throughout the UI.

To get the latest update, restarting Steam may be required.
